Definition: properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider
BiblicalUsage: Baqar means to look after, to inspect, to seek out with care. God says He will seek out His sheep as a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day of cloud and darkness, the priest looks carefully at the plague to judge it, and the psalmist says he will dwell in the house of the Lord to behold the beauty of the Lord and to enquire in His temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the word for God's attention to us. He does not glance at His flock and move on; He seeks, He inspects, He looks after, and I hold that the God who seeks His sheep in the cloudy day is the same God who lets us seek His face in His house.
